tc filter add dev wlp0s20f3 parent 1: protocol all prio 5 matchall action connmark continue
tc filter add dev wlp0s20f3 parent 1: protocol all prio 40 handle 0x10/0xf0 fw action drop

make_n.start-capture:
mkdir -p /C
mkdir -p /S/yt_1
# v2 (t37, chaos): the session dir can be on exFAT, where `tcpdump -w FILE` fails ("Couldn't change ownership of
# savefile") and writes only the header. A root shell opens the file and tcpdump writes to stdout, so tcpdump never
# opens or chowns it; `exec` makes tcpdump sudo's direct child, so stop-capture's SIGINT reaches it via sudo.
sudo sh -c 'exec tcpdump -i lvi_tt -U -w - "not (udp port 41641 or tcp port 22)" > "/T/incoming.pcap" 2> "/T/tcpdump_in.err"' & echo $! > /C/lvi_tt.pid
sudo sh -c 'exec tcpdump -i lvo_tt -U -w - "not (udp port 41641 or tcp port 22)" > "/T/outgoing.pcap" 2> "/T/tcpdump_out.err"' & echo $! > /C/lvo_tt.pid
echo "✅ Capture started"
make_n.start_chrome:
echo "🚀 Starting Chrome with remote debugging..."
LAUNCH_USER=${SUDO_USER:-${USER}}; \
mkdir -p /P/prof; \
chown -R $LAUNCH_USER /P/prof 2>/dev/null || true; \
CHROME_ARGS="--no-sandbox --user-data-dir=/P/prof --remote-debugging-port=9225 --remote-allow-origins=* --disable-features=ChromeWhatsNewUI,OptimizationGuideModelDownloading,OptimizationHintsFetching,OptimizationTargetPrediction,OptimizationHints,OptimizationGuideOnDeviceModel --no-first-run --disable-default-apps --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required --mute-audio --enable-unsafe-extension-debugging --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --disable-sync --disable-domain-reliability --no-default-browser-check --load-extension=<REPO>/labeling about:blank"; \
if [ "$LAUNCH_USER" = "$(id -un)" ]; then \
<REPO>/networkSim/in_cgroup.sh lvdc.slice/tt env SSLKEYLOGFILE=/S/yt_1/ssl_keys.log /usr/bin/google-chrome $CHROME_ARGS > /C/chrome_tt.log 2>&1 & \
else \
<REPO>/networkSim/in_cgroup.sh lvdc.slice/tt sudo -u $LAUNCH_USER env SSLKEYLOGFILE=/S/yt_1/ssl_keys.log /usr/bin/google-chrome $CHROME_ARGS > /C/chrome_tt.log 2>&1 & \
fi; \
echo $! > /C/chrome_tt.pid
echo "✅ Chrome launched (debug port 9225, log → /C/chrome_tt.log)"
make_n.stop-capture:
echo "🛑 Stopping capture..."
if [ -f /C/lvi_tt.pid ]; then \
PID=`cat /C/lvi_tt.pid`; \
sudo kill -INT $PID; \
for i in $(seq 50); do sudo kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done; \
rm /C/lvi_tt.pid; \
fi
if [ -f /C/lvo_tt.pid ]; then \
PID=`cat /C/lvo_tt.pid`; \
sudo kill -INT $PID; \
for i in $(seq 50); do sudo kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done; \
rm /C/lvo_tt.pid; \
fi
# (the loop above waits up to 10 s for tcpdump to flush and exit; `sudo wait` never waited: wait is a shell builtin)
echo "✅ Capture fully stopped"

CHROME_ARGS="--no-sandbox --user-data-dir=/P/prof --remote-debugging-port=9223 --remote-allow-origins=* --disable-features=ChromeWhatsNewUI,OptimizationGuideModelDownloading,OptimizationHintsFetching,OptimizationTargetPrediction,OptimizationHints,OptimizationGuideOnDeviceModel --no-first-run --disable-default-apps --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required --mute-audio --enable-unsafe-extension-debugging --disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows --disable-renderer-backgrounding --disable-background-timer-throttling --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --disable-sync --disable-domain-reliability --no-default-browser-check --load-extension=<REPO>/labeling about:blank"; \
if [ "$LAUNCH_USER" = "$(id -un)" ]; then \
<REPO>/networkSim/in_cgroup.sh lvdc.slice/yt env SSLKEYLOGFILE=/S/yt_1/ssl_keys.log /usr/bin/google-chrome $CHROME_ARGS > /C/chrome_yt.log 2>&1 & \
else \
<REPO>/networkSim/in_cgroup.sh lvdc.slice/yt sudo -u $LAUNCH_USER env SSLKEYLOGFILE=/S/yt_1/ssl_keys.log /usr/bin/google-chrome $CHROME_ARGS > /C/chrome_yt.log 2>&1 & \
fi; \
echo $! > /C/chrome_yt.pid
echo "✅ Chrome launched (debug port 9223, log → /C/chrome_yt.log)"
make_n.stop-capture:
echo "🛑 Stopping capture..."
if [ -f /C/lvi_yt.pid ]; then \
PID=`cat /C/lvi_yt.pid`; \
sudo kill -INT $PID; \
for i in $(seq 50); do sudo kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done; \
rm /C/lvi_yt.pid; \
fi
if [ -f /C/lvo_yt.pid ]; then \
PID=`cat /C/lvo_yt.pid`; \
sudo kill -INT $PID; \
for i in $(seq 50); do sudo kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.2; done; \
rm /C/lvo_yt.pid; \
fi
# (the loop above waits up to 10 s for tcpdump to flush and exit; `sudo wait` never waited: wait is a shell builtin)
echo "✅ Capture fully stopped"
